description_en: Queries the information about all active streams under a specified domain name or a specified application under a domain name
description_zh: 查询指定域名或者指定域名下某个应用的所有在线流信息
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-streams-online-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamsOnlineList

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that you have the permissions to manage the domain name
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. Only a single StreamName can be specified. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流名称，仅支持输入单个StreamName。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return only specified fields. Valid values:  

yes: Only the DomainName, AppName, StreamName, and PublishTime fields are returned.  

no (default): All fields are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否只返回指定字段。取值：  

yes：结果只返回DomainName，AppName，StreamName，PublishTime 字段。  

no（默认值）：结果返回全部字段
parameters.name: only_stream

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 3000. Default value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值范围：1~3000，默认值为2000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:  

all (default): all streams.
  
raw: raw streams.
  
trans: transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
流类型。取值：  

all（默认值）：查询所有流。
  
raw：查询原始流。
  
trans：查询转码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:

fuzzy (default): fuzzy match.

strict: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值：

fuzzy（默认值）：模糊匹配。

strict：精准匹配
parameters.name: query_type

LiveStreamOnlineInfo.description_en: The information about the streams that are being ingested

items.description_en: The information about the streams that are being ingested

AppName.description_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs

AudioDataRate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the live stream. Unit: Kbps.
This parameter is available only after you submit a ticket to enable the whitelist configuration. For more information about how to submit a ticket, see Contact Us
AudioDataRate.description_zh:
直播流的音频码率。单位：Kbps。
此参数需提交工单添加白名单配置后开启，关于如何提交工单，请参见联系我们

ClientIp.description_en: The IP address of the ingest client

DomainName.description_en: The streaming domain of the streamer

Height.description_en: The height of the video resolution. Unit: pixel

PublishDomain.description_en: The ingest domain. If you use live center ingest, you can directly specify the streaming domain
PublishDomain.description_zh: 推流域名，使用中心推流的可直接填写播流域名

PublishTime.description_en: The time when stream ingest started. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
PublishTime.description_zh: 开始推流时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

PublishType.description_en:
The ingest type. Valid values:

edge: edge ingest.

center: live center ingest
PublishType.description_zh:
推流类型，取值：

edge：边缘推流。

center：中心推流

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the ingest node

Transcoded.description_en:
Indicates whether the stream is a transcoded stream. Valid values:

yes: The stream is a transcoded stream.

no: The stream is not a transcoded stream
Transcoded.description_zh:
是否是转码流。取值：

yes：是。

no：否

VideoDataRate.description_en:
The video bitrate of the live stream. Unit: Kbps.
This parameter is available only after you submit a ticket to enable the whitelist configuration. For more information about how to submit a ticket, see Contact Us
VideoDataRate.description_zh:
直播流的视频码率。单位：Kbps。
此参数需提交工单添加白名单配置后开启，关于如何提交工单，请参见联系我们

Width.description_en: The width of the video resolution. Unit: pixel

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the specified conditions
